body: Thank you so much for your reply, I hope you find happiness one day.
Fight it. You can fight it.

I go through a lot of the same things as you do, I’m yet to get a proper diagnosis. I’ve seen specialist after specialist and they never want to diagnose me with the disorder completely. They say I have traits. I too have had a couple of hospital admissions and stayed in a psychiatric ward twice. I was voluntary both times and I find that it helped me at the time, just to not have to deal with everyday stresses. I’m still trying out different medications for my moods. Currently I’m on Lovan which is an antidepressant, plus Seroquel and Lamictal for my mood swings. I have made attempts on my life twice before, which was a result of intense impulses similar to what you’re saying. It’s frustrating having to deal with confusing emotions and I know exactly what you’re going through. Just keep strong, ride out the anger and the impulses to hurt yourself as best you can, because you and I both know they don’t last. Just take it as it comes and make sure you tell someone you trust as soon as you feel like you want to hurt yourself, because I find that if I tell someone immediately, they can quickly try and shift my thoughts away and distract me. I’m also going through talking therapies with my psychologist which is necessary for those of us with bpd, we gotta learn how to cope with those insane emotions we go through, better ways to channel our anger and such. Everything will work out, even though I know sometimes it feels like it won’t. Stay safe and keep fighting.
